title: A deathsman of the soul Robert Greene called him
html_source:
Robert Greene, a contemporary of Shakespeare wrote

in which is widely thought to be the first literary reference to Shakespeare. Greene, in this posthumous autobiographical pamphlet called Shakespeare an ‘upstart crow’. In Groatsworth (Gifford) Greene calls Lust, not Shakespeare A deathsman of the soul.
